name: Jaune-Mange
description: Historical recipe from Common Sense in the Household (1871). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: Coxe's gelatine, soaked in half a cup cold water one hour
ingredients.originalText: 1 oz. Coxe's gelatine, soaked in half a cup cold water one hour

ingredients.name: Yolks of four eggs beaten very light
ingredients.originalText: Yolks of four eggs beaten very light

ingredients.name: orange, juice and half the grated peel
ingredients.originalText: 1 orange, juice and half the grated peel

ingredients.name: lemon, juice and one-third the grated peel
ingredients.originalText: 1 lemon, juice and one-third the grated peel

ingredients.name: 1 cup white wine or clear pale Sherry
ingredients.originalText: 1 cup white wine or clear pale Sherry
ingredients.quantityText: 1 cup white wine or clear pale Sherry

ingredients.name: powdered sugar and a good pinch cinnamon
ingredients.originalText: 1 cup powdered sugar and a good pinch cinnamon

instructions.text: Stir the soaked gelatine in the boiling water until dissolved; take from the fire and beat, a little at a time, into the yolks; return to the inner saucepan with the sugar, orange, lemon and cinnamon.
Stir over a clear fire until it is boiling hot; put in the wine and strain through a hair-sieve or a piece of tarlatan.
Set away in a mould wet with cold water.

source.author: Marion Harland
source.originalInstructions:
1. Stir the soaked gelatine in the boiling water until dissolved; take from the fire and beat, a little at a time, into the yolks; return to the inner saucepan with the sugar, orange, lemon and cinnamon.
2. Stir over a clear fire until it is boiling hot; put in the wine and strain through a hair-sieve or a piece of tarlatan.
3. Set away in a mould wet with cold water.
originalIngredients: 1 oz. Coxe's gelatine, soaked in half a cup cold water one hour
Yolks of four eggs beaten very light
1 orange, juice and half the grated peel
1 lemon, juice and one-third the grated peel
1 cup white wine or clear pale Sherry
1 cup powdered sugar and a good pinch cinnamon
